subject: VastHealth — security exhibit negotiation & evidence cadence
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: VastHealth — security exhibit negotiation & evidence cadence

Team — quick sync. VastHealth has pushed back on a few MSA/order form clauses around audit rights and pen-test language. Procurement looped me in and attached their redline (see attached). High-level asks from them: SOC 2 report on file, ability to trigger an inspection with 30 days' notice, and explicit language about log retention and redaction of PII in evidence packages.

I flagged that we generally: provide SOC 2 report summary and SOC report under NDA, allow scoped pen-tests with staging access/ephemeral creds, and propose an evidence cadence (quarterly sample set + ad-hoc for incidents). They want the order form to call out audit rights more broadly.

Can Legal weigh in on the following by EOD today?
- A short paragraph that preserves our bounded inspection approach (no broad forensic access) but satisfies their procurement team
- Pen-test window language that balances their right to validate security with our staging/ops constraints
- Confirmation of what we can include in an evidence bundle (sample logs, obfuscated PII, SOC 2 summary)

Attachment: redline_vasthealth_orderform.docx (tracked changes)

Thanks — I can join a quick call if helpful.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher | Head of Platform Partnerships

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: VastHealth — security exhibit negotiation & evidence cadence

On Wed, Nov 3, 2027 at 9:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — quick sync. VastHealth has pushed back on a few MSA/order form clauses around audit rights and pen-test language.

Thanks for the context, Sean. I reviewed the attached redline and sketched a proposed approach in the attached file (legal_proposed_redline.docx). Summary of recommended edits:

1) Audit rights: insert limited "Assurance Inspection" clause that permits evidence production and bounded inspection of non-production/staging environments only, with a mutually agreeable notice window (we suggest 30–45 days) and use of tamper-evident access tokens. We explicitly deny unfettered forensic access to prod systems.

2) Pen-test language: allow customer-initiated pen-tests subject to (a) a runbook agreed 14 days in advance, (b) scope carveouts for third-party infra, and (c) a max one ad-hoc window per 12 months unless mutually agreed. Require testers to follow our responsible disclosure contact and to coordinate with our ops lead.

3) Evidence cadence and PII: commit to quarterly sampled evidence and a one-off incident-response evidence packet. All evidence will be redacted to remove customer PII and only metadata/aggregate logs will be shared where possible. We will provide SOC 2 Type II summary and make the full report available under NDA.

Questions for Sean/Grace: who is the internal ops contact to coordinate staging access and token issuance? Also confirm if we can accept their request to have a named third-party run the test (we prefer to vet/approve vendors).

Attachment: legal_proposed_redline.docx (redline suggestions inline)

Karthik Iyer
Counsel, Contracts & Security
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Amy Liu <amy.liu@vasthealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vasthealth.com
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 08:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: VastHealth — security exhibit negotiation & evidence cadence

Hi Sean / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We appreciate the proposed language from legal and the willingness to provide SOC 2 under NDA. A few clarifications from our side (procurement + security):

- SOC 2: please provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report (2027) or a bridge letter if not yet finalized. We will sign an NDA for the report.
- Notice window: 30 days is our preference for inspections; we can be flexible if you need 45 days for complex ops, but please confirm the upper bound.
- Pen-test vendor: we prefer to use our third-party tester (ProbingLabs). If Redwood requires vendor approval, please confirm the process and target turnaround time for approval (we need <7 business days).
- Evidence bundle: we need sampled request logs (7 days), auth traces for sampled sessions, and proof of redaction for any PII. We understand you may provide obfuscated logs; please confirm the format (CSV/JSON) and retention period for logs you can export.

I attached our security questionnaire with the specific fields procurement needs filled.

Attachment: VH_security_questions.xlsx

If you can confirm these items by COB Friday (Nov 5), procurement will move to finalize the PO. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if that speeds alignment.

Best,
Amy Liu
Senior Procurement Manager
VastHealth
amy.liu@vasthealth.com | +1 617-555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2027 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: VastHealth — security exhibit negotiation & evidence cadence

Thanks Amy — copying the internal thread so we have a consolidated plan. Key decisions and next steps (internal):

- SOC 2: Ops will upload SOC2-report-2027.pdf to the secure drive and we will send under NDA. Sean, can you trigger the NDA and routing? HubSpot has VH record HS-43821 — I'll add the NDA link there.
- Notice window: Legal proposes 30–45 days; we will offer 45 days as a conservative default and note we can accept 30 days for expedited commercial deals with limited staging impact.
- Pen-test vendor: we will accept customer-named vendor pending our standard vendor check (security questionnaire + proof of insurance). Target turnaround for vendor approval: 5 business days.
- Evidence bundle: we will commit to CSV/JSON exports, 7-day sample windows, and PII redaction proof. Ops needs to prepare an evidence runbook for VastHealth.

Action owners and dates: 
- Sean: send NDA + SOC2 report link to Amy (by EOD Fri Nov 5)
- Karthik: fold proposed redline into the MSA/order form and return a clean tracked version (by Mon Nov 8)
- Grace (Ops): draft evidence runbook and token issuance checklist (by Tue Nov 9)

Related links: HubSpot HS-43821; DocuSign template for NDA (https://www.docusign.com/transaction/EX-9a2b7c)

I'll take the central point on coordination with procurement. If we hit any legal pushback on one-off access, we'll escalate, but this plan should keep the deal moving.

Laura Bennett
